name: Motosu (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Motosu city emblem in white: a disc bearing green horizontal strokes and four green discs.
history: Municipal flag of Motosu, a city in Gifu Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 15 May 2004.

features.role: Motosu city emblem — a disc bearing green horizontal strokes and four green discs
